resources.string: Accept developer installs from easyide-ext dev: pushed over adb, or requested from the open project with dev --local. Reloads with the same capabilities install without asking.
Developer install: first install of this extension.
Developer install: replaces the installed non-developer copy.
Developer install: capabilities changed since the last approval (%1$s new).
WASM templates (Rust, AssemblyScript) need a toolchain: use easyide-ext init in a terminal.
Lowercase letters, digits and -; the id is publisher.name.
Create a project first: the extension is written into a project folder.
Written to %1$s/ in the project. Edit it there, then install it from that folder.
Developer mode is on: after installing, run easyide-ext dev --local --watch %1$s in a terminal of this project to reload on every save.
Turn on Settings > Extensions > Developer mode to reload it on save with easyide-ext dev --local.
A folder named %1$s already exists in that project and is not empty.
%1$s is not a valid extension id: use lowercase letters, digits and -.
The template is missing from this build (%1$s).
